nonblocking_limitations.issue: Anchor preprocessing is a declared variant
nonblocking_limitations.detail: OpenCV INTER_AREA on uint8 anchor is not certified equal to the original S68/S70 Torch FP32 adaptive area plus truncate conversion. Contract explicitly selects OpenCV; therefore source matches its declared exploratory contract, but this review does not approve a claim of identical preprocessing. Kernel/rounding differences can change keypoints and are an additional observer limitation. For an identical-preprocessing claim, change to the original helper path before execution.

nonblocking_limitations.issue: Payload values not independently read during source audit
nonblocking_limitations.detail: Whole NPZ byte SHA is checked by worker and fields decoded selectively: ids/c2ws plus K_pixels_576. Existing bound camera validation is reused. Actual baseline, K values, matches, line validity and residuals await real execution and independent arithmetic.

Caught failures preserve earlier pairs; an external hard stop can leave only partial artifacts. COMPLETE_REAL_CONTROL_DIAGNOSTIC means the loop finished, including explicit insufficient outcomes, not camera or scientific PASS.

scope: Only source/protocol/schema metadata read, and stdlib compile/static metadata comparisons executed. No imports of measure.py, scientific arrays, image headers/bodies, GT bodies, model weights, SIFT or numerical geometry execution. Supporting source read in relevant sections; exact S72 source and contract read fully.
upcoming_runtime: Root owns the single externally bounded 60-second execution. No run is authorized merely by an inferred absence of mismatches; existing root authorization applies to the explicitly declared exploratory contract.
interpretation_limits: Approximate ROS K and no undistortion remain; no calibrated lens claim.
Real fr2_desk identity is bound by actual metadata; prior fr1 discussion is inapplicable.
Fixed F tests a necessary relation only; low error does not validate pose/depth, correspondence truth, generated-image geometry or memory causality.
All fractions <=2/5/10 px are descriptive, with valid-line denominators and invalid counts explicit.
